messages:
Jamie: Quick sync — iterative pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy + inbound lead routing. Workshop tomorrow 10am. Goal: tighten hero clarity and map leads to the right team. Who can join?
Sofia: I can. Prioritize headline tests: 'Predictable throughput' vs 'SLA-backed performance' — they land differently for PMs vs procurement. :thinking_face:
Alex: Count me in. For routing we should map by company_size + use_case. Also want to add a webinar CTA variant (benchmarks-focused).
Mira: I’ll need constraints: hero must remain 3 lines on mobile. If we change verbage, I’ll need new screenshots for Dedicated capacity.
Priya: Suggest a microcopy path: quick survey on hero — "Which mode fits your workload?" That should reduce bounce/confusion between Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Jamie: Good — add that as a tiny interactive module under hero. Also we should surface one benchmark stat on each page (p95 latency or tokens/sec).
Sofia: Proposed A/B plan: Variant A = problem-first (latency/cost tradeoff), Variant B = product-first (how it works + modes). Run 2 weeks, target geos NA/EU.
Alex: For inbound routing (HubSpot) sketch:
```
# pseudo-mapping
if form.company_size >= 500:
  owner = \"enterprise-sales\"
elif form.use_case == \"regulated\":
  owner = \"solutions\"
else:
  owner = \"growth\"
# add tag: mode_interest = form.selected_mode (hosted|dedicated|private)
```
Sofia: Can we also add a hidden field for 'benchmarks_interest' when they click webinar CTA so we auto-add to the benchmark nurture list?
Alex: Yes. Also add rule: if selected_mode == 'private' -> route to solutions AND set priority = high.
Mira: I'll mock 3 hero variants tonight and push to the drive: small-screen text-only, text+stats, text+micro-survey.
Priya: Drafting the microcopy now. Two quick options: (1) "Start with Hosted — scale later" (2) "Need isolation & SLAs? Try Dedicated/Private". Will share by 5pm.
Jamie: Perfect. Can someone own the webinar landing copy? Need the short narrative: benchmark results + customer Q&A + signup.
Sofia: I’ll draft webinar headline + 3 bullet points. Also propose a 3-line subtitle emphasizing impartial benchmarks.
Alex: I'll wire up the HubSpot field mapping and the automation rules after Sofia posts the final form fields.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Landing copy workshop" — tomorrow 10:00–11:00 — https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 :calendar:
Mira: :thumbsup: I uploaded PNG comps to /drive/marketing/landing-hero-variants.
Priya: Shared Persona paths doc and microcopy A/B in the same folder.
Jamie: Action items: Sofia = webinar + A/B plan, Alex = HubSpot mapping & automations, Mira = hero comps, Priya = microcopy + persona paths. We’ll review in the workshop and pick the top headline per page. Thanks all. :rocket:
Sofia: One more — can we include a tiny inline FAQ for Private about compliance (KMS/HSM, audit logs)? Low friction, high signal for security folks.
Jamie: Yes — short bullets only. Keep it scannable.
Alex: I'll add a tracking param for each CTA so we can measure which headline drives webinar signups.
Mira: On it. Mockups will include CTA variants.
Priya: Will draft the FAQ micro-bullets and the microcopy choices into the doc before the call.
Jamie: Great. See you tomorrow.
